request: Hey Claude, I just added the "customer-segmentation-rfm" skill. Build RFM segments from our Shopify orders, check how each segment responds to our Klaviyo emails, and give me a plan per segment. We never go above 15% off.
note: Example data: an invented online tea store, not a real business. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input.

settings.counts_as_a_sale: paid or partially refunded, not cancelled, not test, net value above 0
settings.customer_key: Shopify customer id (the example leaves emails out; with emails present, customers are keyed on lowercased email)

data_pulled.fields: email, created, subscriptions (can_receive_email_marketing), phone_number, first_name, last_name, location (country, zip)
